sections.lead: We design SaaS platforms, dashboards, and mobile products for founders and product leaders — from a first MVP to a mature product your team ships against every week.

sections.body: Radiant is a boutique product design studio. We design product UX and UI for SaaS, fintech, and marketplace teams: UX audits, user flows, interface design, design systems, and animated product visualizations. Engagements run from a two-week audit to an embedded design partner, with senior work delivered every 48 hours. sections.label: Product Design
sections.challenge: Your product has users, but they're not converting, retaining, or expanding the way the business needs them to. Features pile up. Flows get longer. The interface drifts further from the simplicity your users expected when they signed up.

cards.title: Onboarding that never reaches value
cards.body: People sign up, land in an empty product, and never reach the moment that proves it works. We design the shortest honest path to first value, and the empty states that carry users there.

cards.title: Core flows that grew by accident
cards.body: The flow that worked for one use case now serves four, with branches nobody designed. We map it as it is, then redraw it around the job the user actually came to do.

cards.title: A system drifting out of sync
cards.body: Buttons in sizes nobody agreed on, colours that shift between screens, engineers rebuilding the same component. We tokenize what exists and document what ships.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.title: Audit and align
steps.body: We review the product as it is, read your analytics, and talk to your team about where users stall. You get a written audit with the problems ranked by revenue impact, not by how easy they are to fix.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.title: Flows, then interface
steps.body: We redraw the core journeys and sign them off with your engineers before any pixel is placed. Then interface design, states, and micro-interactions, delivered in reviewable batches every 48 hours.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.title: Handoff that survives the sprint
steps.body: Components, tokens, and annotations your developers can build from without a meeting. We stay available through implementation so the shipped product matches the designed one.

sections.heading: Trusted by our partners
sections.name: Aaron D.
sections.quote: Radiant exceeded all our expectations! Design and animations quality are on top level.

cards.title: What does a product design agency do?
cards.body: A product design agency designs how software works and looks: user flows, interface design, states, and the design system that keeps it consistent. Radiant works as an embedded partner — we join your product process rather than delivering a file and leaving.

cards.title: How much does product design cost?
cards.body: A focused UX audit starts at [PLACEHOLDER: price]. A full product design engagement is scoped by surface area and runs [PLACEHOLDER: range]. Ongoing partnerships are billed monthly. We quote after a call, never from a template.

cards.title: How long does a product design project take?
cards.body: An audit takes two weeks. A core flow redesign takes four to six. A full product design engagement typically runs eight to twelve weeks from kickoff to handoff, with work in your hands every 48 hours throughout.

cards.title: Can you work with our existing design system?
cards.body: Yes. We audit what you have, work inside it, and tell you plainly where it is costing you speed. Rebuilding a system is a separate decision we will not make for you mid-project.

cards.title: Do you work directly with our engineers?
cards.body: Yes, and the work is better when we do. We sign flows off with engineering before visual design starts, so what we hand over is buildable against your real data and constraints.

cards.title: Do you design mobile apps as well as web?
cards.body: Yes. Native iOS and Android patterns, responsive web, and the places they have to agree. [PLACEHOLDER: link a mobile case study once published.]

sections.label: Next step
sections.challenge: Send us your product and the metric you want to move. We will come back with what we would change first and what it would take — before you commit to anything.
